message.content:
Design a concrete implementation plan (do NOT write code, just produce a plan) for a feature in the repo C:\Users\Micro\3D Objects\DEV\deliveryhub_white_label (React/Vite frontend) + submodule server_delivery (NestJS backend, Supabase/Postgres).

## Goal (confirmed with user via clarifying questions)
1. Every field where an address is collected must require "número" (house number) — currently optional everywhere.
2. Customer address becomes effectively mandatory: keep the EXISTING checkout gate (shopping-cart-checkout's StepEndereco already requires `logradouro`), just also require `numero` there and in customer-profile page. No new blocking beyond checkout — customers can still browse the menu without an address.
3. Add a user avatar/photo to the customer-facing header (`src/components/ui/BrandedHeader.jsx`) that when clicked opens `/customer-profile` (existing page) so the user can complete/edit name, phone, address. Scope confirmed: ONLY the customer-facing header — NOT the restaurant-owner dashboard nav, NOT the motoboy portal.
4. Reuse the existing ViaCEP autofill pattern (`src/utils/viaCep.js`, `buscarCep(cep)`) consistently — `customer-profile/index.jsx` currently does NOT call it on CEP change (bug/gap), while `shopping-cart-checkout/StepEndereco.jsx` already does (`handleCepChange`). Fix customer-profile to match StepEndereco's pattern.
5. Make the home-page "filtro geográfico" (radius/km filter) actually benefit from a saved, geocoded customer address as a fallback when live browser GPS isn't available/granted, instead of being 100% dependent on `navigator.geolocation` every visit.

## Facts already established (verified by direct code reads — build the plan around these, don't re-derive)

**Customer address & profile:**
- Backend: `server_delivery/src/perfil/perfil.service.ts` — `getMeuPerfil(userId)` and `updateMeuPerfil(userId, {name, phone_e164, address_json})`, both operate on Supabase table `customers` (columns: `id, name, email, phone_e164, address_json` selected today). Controller: `server_delivery/src/perfil/perfil.controller.ts`.
- `customers.address_json` is a JSONB with shape `{logradouro, numero, complemento, bairro, cidade, estado, cep, referencia}`.
- **The `customers` table ALSO already has `lat`, `lng`, `address_geocode_hash`, `address_geocoded_at` columns** (confirmed via `server_delivery/src/pedidos/pedidos.service.ts` lines ~74-96, method `geocodificarEnderecoCliente(customerId)`): it hashes `address_json`, skips if unchanged, else joins `logradouro, numero, bairro, cidade, estado, cep` into one string and calls `this.geocoding.geocodeEndereco(texto)` (Nominatim via `server_delivery/src/motoboy/geocoding.service.ts`, `GeocodingService.geocodeEndereco(texto): Promise<{lat,lng}|null>`, rate-limited ~1req/s), then updates `lat, lng, address_geocode_hash, address_geocoded_at`. Today this is `private` on `PedidosService`, called ONLY from `criar()` (order creation) and ONLY when `restaurant.motoboy_comissao_tipo === 'km'` (fire-and-forget `.catch(()=>{})`) — i.e. it does NOT run when the customer edits their profile, and PerfilService has no access to it.
- Frontend profile page: `src/pages/customer-profile/index.jsx` — full form (name, phone, logradouro, numero, complemento, bairro, cidade, estado, cep, referencia) using a local `Campo` component. Saves via `src/services/perfilService.js` (`getPerfil`/`updatePerfil`, confirm exact functions by reading this file). Validation today only requires `name` + `phone_e164` (not address, not numero). CEP field has NO onChange autofill — just `set('cep')`.
- Checkout address form: `src/pages/shopping-cart-checkout/StepEndereco.jsx` — has `handleCepChange` that calls `buscarCep` from `src/utils/viaCep.js` on 8-digit CEP and fills `logradouro/bairro/cidade/estado` (never `numero` — ViaCEP doesn't return house numbers). Validation requires `logradouro` but not `numero` currently.
- Other ViaCEP consumers (same `buscarCep` util): `src/pages/restaurant-registration-setup/components/ContactDetailsForm.jsx`, `src/pages/restaurante-config/index.jsx` — these are RESTAURANT addresses (owner-side), out of scope for "every user must have address" (restaurant address already required for the business to operate) but if they collect `numero` today check whether it's optional too; if so make it required there as well for consistency since user said "all address fields".

**Avatar / header:**
- `src/components/ui/BrandedHeader.jsx` — the customer-facing header used across customer pages (menu-catalog-product-browse, etc). Has a dropdown user menu triggered by a generic `<Icon name="User">` glyph (NOT a real avatar image), showing name/email/role, a "Meus pedidos" link (navigates to `/customer-account-order-history`), and "Sair". **No link to `/customer-profile` exists today.** Uses `useAuth()` from `src/contexts/AuthContext` for `{user, userProfile, isAuthenticated, signOut}`.
- `customers` table has **no photo/avatar column at all** today (confirmed — `perfil.service.ts` select list doesn't include one).
- Reusable pattern for photo upload + signed URL already exists for **motoboys**: `server_delivery/src/motoboy/motoboy-auth.service.ts` (`uploadDocumento(motoboyId, 'foto-perfil', base64Body)` → Supabase storage) and `server_delivery/src/motoboy/motoboy.service.ts` has a `signedUrl()` helper used whenever `foto_perfil_url` is returned to clients. This is the pattern to copy for customers (new `customers.foto_perfil_url` column, reuse/adapt the upload-to-storage + signed-URL helper, or determine if a shared upload utility already exists that both could call — check `server_delivery/src/restaurante/restaurante.service.ts`'s `storage/upload` endpoint mentioned in `restauranteService.js` line ~162, `apiPath('/api/restaurante')}/storage/upload` — evaluate if THAT generic upload endpoint is simpler to reuse for the customer avatar than copying motoboy's bespoke Supabase-storage-signed-URL flow).

**Home geo filter:**
- `src/pages/menu-catalog-product-browse/index.jsx` (~line 531 `localizacao` state, ~541 `navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition`, ~620-638 builds query params `lat/lng/raio_km` sent to `GET /api/r`). 100% browser-GPS-driven today, `statusLocalizacao` state tracks permission ('ok'|'indisponivel'|etc — read the file to get the full enum). Also has manual Estado/Cidade/Bairro/CEP dropdown filters (`filtroEstado` etc, `temFiltroManual` flag) as an alternate path, sourced from a separate `/api/r/filtros` endpoint — unrelated to lat/lng.
- Backend: `server_delivery/src/restaurante/catalogo.controller.ts` (or wherever `GET /api/r` lives — confirm exact file) computes `haversineKm` against each restaurant's own `lat/lng`, filtered by `raio_km` (options `[5,10,15,25,50,0]`, default 15).
- Plan should add: when the logged-in customer has NOT granted live GPS (or as an available option), fall back to their saved+geocoded `customers.lat/lng` (only available if authenticated — guest/anonymous browsing still needs live GPS or manual filters, no change there).

**Motoboys:** explicitly OUT of scope per user's own phrasing ("motoboys seus documentos ok") — they keep their existing document-upload flow only, no new address fields, no avatar.

## What the plan must specify concretely
1. Exact backend changes: which files/methods change for (a) requiring `numero`, (b) exposing geocoding-on-profile-save from `PerfilService` (decide: inject `GeocodingService` directly into `PerfilService` and duplicate the small hash-check-and-geocode block from `pedidos.service.ts`'s `geocodificarEnderecoCliente`, OR extract that logic into a shared reusable method on `GeocodingService` itself called from both `PedidosService` and `PerfilService` — pick ONE and justify briefly, favor minimal duplication AND minimal new cross-service coupling), (c) new `customers.foto_perfil_url` column + upload endpoint (decide whether to reuse the existing generic `restaurante/storage/upload` endpoint pattern or add a new small endpoint under `perfil` — check `server_delivery/src/restaurante/restaurante.service.ts`'s storage upload method signature first via a Read before deciding), (d) any change needed in `catalogo.controller.ts` / the `GET /api/r` handler to accept an authenticated customer's saved lat/lng as an alternative to query-string lat/lng (e.g. when request is authenticated and no lat/lng query params were sent, look up `customers.lat/lng` server-side) — this is the cleanest way to make the fallback work without trusting client-supplied "fallback" coordinates.
2. Exact frontend changes: `customer-profile/index.jsx` (require numero + name+phone+address as a whole before allowing save OR just make numero required alongside existing required fields — match to the "bloqueia no checkout" decision, i.e. this page itself doesn't need to hard-block, just needs numero validation and ViaCEP autofill added), `shopping-cart-checkout/StepEndereco.jsx` (add numero to required validation), `BrandedHeader.jsx` (avatar image + click → navigate `/customer-profile`, with sensible fallback when no photo uploaded — e.g. initials or the existing User icon), `menu-catalog-product-browse/index.jsx` (fallback logic: only call geolocation as today; if permission denied/unavailable AND user is authenticated, let the backend fallback handle it by simply omitting lat/lng from the request when authenticated so the backend can use the saved address — confirm this is simpler than duplicating geocoding client-side).
3. A short DB migration note (this repo's Supabase schema is managed via dashboard, not tracked SQL migrations in server_delivery — confirm by checking if there's a migrations folder in server_delivery vs the frontend repo's `supabase/migrations/` folder found earlier) — the plan should say exactly what column(s) need to be added directly in Supabase (e.g. `customers.foto_perfil_url text`) since there's no migration file workflow to author here.
4. Order of implementation (backend columns/endpoints first, then frontend) and a manual verification checklist (e.g. edit profile with new address+numero+photo → confirm `customers.lat/lng` populated → visit home page without granting GPS while logged in → confirm restaurants filtered by that address's location).

Write the plan as clear prose/bullets with concrete file paths (no need to write actual code). Keep it tight — this will be read by someone who already knows the codebase context above, so don't re-explain the "facts already established" section back, just build on it. Flag any remaining open question you find that genuinely needs the user's input rather than guessing.

content.text:
## Implementation Plan

### 0. Open questions that need your input before/while implementing

**A. `BrandedHeader.jsx` is dead code — not wired into any route.** I verified this directly: `grep -r "BrandedHeader" src` only matches the component's own definition file. Every customer-facing page has its own bespoke inline `<header>` (home page: `src/pages/menu-catalog-product-browse/index.jsx` lines 683-756; also separate inline headers in `customer-account-order-history/index.jsx`, `shopping-cart-checkout/index.jsx`, `order-tracking-status/*`). None import `BrandedHeader`.
Recommendation (used below): implement the avatar in the **home page header** (`menu-catalog-product-browse/index.jsx`, lines 683-756) since that's the actual "customer-facing header" users see everywhere they browse, rather than editing the unused `BrandedHeader.jsx` in isolation (which would have zero visible effect). I will NOT attempt the larger refactor of replacing all four pages' duplicated header markup with `BrandedHeader` — that's a much bigger, separate refactor. Please confirm this is acceptable, or tell me if you actually want the avatar duplicated into the other three customer pages' headers too.

**B. Sync vs. fire-and-forget geocoding on profile save.** `pedidos.service.ts` fires geocoding without awaiting (`.catch(() => {})`) so order creation isn't slowed by the ~1.1s Nominatim rate limit. For `PerfilService.updateMeuPerfil`, I plan to `await` it (it's a deliberate "Save profile" click, not a hot path, and the home-page fallback needs `lat/lng` populated by the time the user next visits) — wrapped in try/catch so a Nominatim hiccup never blocks the profile save itself. Flag if you'd rather keep it fire-and-forget for snappier UX at the cost of a possibly-stale/missing `lat/lng` on the very next page load.

**C. `restaurante-config/index.jsx`** (restaurant address edit page, post-onboarding) has no separate "número" field at all — address is one free-text `"Endereço (rua, número)"` field. `restaurant-registration-setup` (initial onboarding) already validates número as required (`index.jsx` lines 148-149) — no change needed there. I'm leaving `restaurante-config` as-is (out of scope, restaurant address already gated at signup) unless you want it restructured to match — low priority, flag if you want it included.

---

### 1. Backend changes

**1a. Require `numero` — backend validation**
- `server_delivery/src/perfil/perfil.service.ts` `updateMeuPerfil`: currently accepts `address_json` unvalidated. Add a small guard: if `body.address_json` is present, require `body.address_json.numero?.trim()` (and while at it, `logradouro`) to be non-empty, else throw `BadRequestException`. This is defense-in-depth since checkout/profile already validate client-side, but a raw API caller shouldn't be able to save an address without número.
- `server_delivery/src/perfil/perfil.controller.ts`: no change needed (just propagates body).

**1b. Geocode on profile save — extract shared logic into `GeocodingService`**
Decision: add a new **pure** method to `server_delivery/src/motoboy/geocoding.service.ts` (not to `PerfilService` directly, and not by having `PerfilService` depend on `PedidosService`) rather than duplicating the hash/geocode block. Justification: `GeocodingService` already has zero DB dependency (pure "text → coords" + rate limit) and is already exported by `MotoboyModule` for cross-domain reuse (`PedidosModule` already imports `MotoboyModule` for exactly this). Having `PerfilModule` depend on `MotoboyModule` for `GeocodingService` is a much lighter, more natural coupling than `PerfilService` depending on `PedidosService` (which would be backwards — profile is a lower-level concern than orders) and avoids duplicating the md5-hash-check logic in two services.

  - Add to `GeocodingService`:
    ```
    async geocodificarEnderecoClienteSeNecessario(addressJson, hashAtual): Promise<{lat, lng, hash} | null>
    ```
    Move the hash-compute + early-return-if-unchanged + `[logradouro, numero, bairro, cidade, estado, cep].filter(Boolean).join(', ')` + `this.geocodeEndereco(texto)` logic here verbatim (currently lines 82-87 of `pedidos.service.ts`'s private `geocodificarEnderecoCliente`). Returns `null` when address is empty or hash unchanged (nothing to update); otherwise returns the new `{lat, lng, hash}`.
  - Refactor `server_delivery/src/pedidos/pedidos.service.ts`'s private `geocodificarEnderecoCliente(customerId)` (lines 74-98) to: select `address_json, address_geocode_hash`, call the new shared method, and if non-null, do the `customers` update (`lat, lng, address_geocode_hash, address_geocoded_at`). Behavior unchanged (still private, still only called from `criar()` fire-and-forget when `motoboy_comissao_tipo === 'km'`).
  - `server_delivery/src/perfil/perfil.module.ts`: add `MotoboyModule` to `imports: [AuthModule, SupabaseModule, MotoboyModule]` (no circular dependency — `MotoboyModule` only imports `AuthModule`/`SupabaseModule`).
  - `server_delivery/src/perfil/perfil.service.ts`: inject `GeocodingService` in the constructor. In `updateMeuPerfil`, after the `customers` row is updated/inserted (whichever branch — both existing-update and first-insert paths), if `body.address_json` was provided, call the new shared method with the row's previous `address_geocode_hash` (need to select it in the initial `existing` lookup, currently only selects `id`) and the new `address_json`; if it returns non-null, do a follow-up `customers` update for `lat/lng/address_geocode_hash/address_geocoded_at` on the same row (await it, wrapped in try/catch so geocoding failure never fails the profile save — see open question B above).

**1c. Avatar upload endpoint**
Decision: add a **new small endpoint under `perfil`**, not reuse `restaurante/storage/upload`. Reasons (confirmed by reading both): `POST /api/restaurante/storage/upload` is guarded by `@UseGuards(RestaurantOwnerGuard)` on the whole `RestauranteController` (`server_delivery/src/restaurante/restaurante.controller.ts` line 11) — a customer JWT would be rejected there, and repurposing it would either require loosening that guard (bad — mixes owner-only and customer-only auth on one controller) or duplicating the controller method elsewhere anyway. It also writes into the `restaurante-imagens` bucket, which is the wrong namespace for customer PII photos.

  - New migration (see §3) adds `customers.foto_perfil_url text`.
